[[General/Legends|General]] '''Fefar Blackeye''' was a [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] who led a rebellion on [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. In just two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] Blackeye executed three successfull [[Guerrilla warfare/Legends|guerrilla]] campaigns up until his capture in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG 9" /> Popular legend had it that an Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commander]] trapped him in a copse of [[Hiakk tree|hiakk]] [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and waited until sunset. Due to the Nosaurian compulsion to bray at sunset, Blackeye inadvertently revealed himself and was captured.<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

Heavily injured and rendered mute, Blackeye was taken to a [[Zoo/Legends|zoo]] near [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he was kept in a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] cage with wild [[Primate/Legends|primates]]. Six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, Blackeye committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]]. Without him, the resistance collapsed. It was not until after the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]]<ref name="SWG 9" /> in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> that the rest of the Nosaurian population learned of Blackeye's fate, which fueled anti-[[Human/Legends|Human]] sentiment among Nosaurians for [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] to come.<ref name="SWG 9" />
